en.title: What Nexwall Endpoint includes
new: Enrolment with a single-use token and a tenant-bound certificate
Mutual TLS ingest that rejects events of another tenant
OCSF 1.10.0 events for process, file, network and DNS activity
Windows sensor verified in the lab
base: Detection and response on Windows, Linux and macOS
Isolation of an endpoint through Nexwall Firewall
Controller console with one tenant per customer
Signed policies and staged agent updates
Detection rules with their author and licence recorded
